configurations.name: Test: Watch current file
configurations.command: f='${file}'; d=$(dirname "$f"); b=$(basename "$f"); ext=$(echo "$b" | sed 's/.*\.//'); stem=$(echo "$b" | sed 's/\.[^.]*$//'); if echo "$f" | grep -qE '\.test\.[tj]sx?$'; then t="$f"; elif [ "$stem" = 'index' ]; then cname=$(basename "$d"); ctest="$d/$cname.test.$ext"; if [ -f "$ctest" ]; then t="$ctest"; else t="$d/index.test.$ext"; fi; else t="$d/$stem.test.$ext"; fi; app=$(echo "$f" | sed -E 's|(.*apps/[^/]+).*|\1|'); cd "$app"; if echo "$f" | grep -q 'distributed-checkout'; then node --import tsx --test --watch "$t"; else npx vitest --watch "$t"; fi
